name: Cafe Crush
source:
A new cafe has opened up and you're finally able to check it out! As you do you seem to bump into a particular character and find yourself infatuated with his.... unique appearance. They do say to never judge a book by its cover after all.

[From [url=https://pipgea.itch.io/cafe-crush]Itch.io[/url]]
